sloka: अधिरुह्य हनूमन्तम् ऐरावतम् इव ईश्वरः ।अन्गदेन एष सम्यातु लक्ष्मणः च अन्तक उपमः ॥६-४-१९॥।।
transliteration: adhiruhya hanūmantam airāvatam iva īśvaraḥ ।angadena eṣa samyātu lakṣmaṇaḥ ca antaka upamaḥ ॥6-4-19॥।।

translations.english: "Let Lakshmana who is like Anthaka (one who excels death) ride on Angada, like the lord of wealth (Kubera) rides on the elephant Saarvabhauma (the elephant that guards the four quarters)".
